invariants.description: at a clamped Cai, NE follows the exact solution NE_init + k_NE max(Cai - Cai_NE_base, 0)/k_NET (1 - exp(-k_NET t)) (relative 1e-4: CVODE atol 1e-10 on a 3.3e-4 mM state; 100 s = 3 NET time constants 1/k_NET = 33 s, so the run covers the relaxation)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(NE - (NE_init + k_NE*max(Cai - Cai_NE_base, 0)/k_NET*(1 - np.exp(-k_NET*t))))) <= 1e-4*max(1e-12, k_NE*max(Cai - Cai_NE_base, 0)/k_NET)
